description: Wire Evolution Analyzer to StatisticalAnalyzer for significance testing and trend analysis
steps: In src/nexus/evolution/analyzer.py, create StatisticalFailureAnalyzer class that extends FailureAnalyzer
Import StatisticalAnalyzer from nexus.evolution.statistical and instantiate in __init__

Add is_significant_pattern(pattern_data: list[float], baseline_data: list[float], alpha: float = 0.05) -> dict method that uses StatisticalAnalyzer.compute_significance to test if a failure pattern is statistically significant vs baseline
Add trend_analysis(metric_values: list[float]) -> dict method that uses StatisticalAnalyzer.detect_trend to identify if failure rates are trending up/down/flat
Add compare_periods(period_a: list[float], period_b: list[float]) -> dict method that uses StatisticalAnalyzer.is_significant_improvement to compare two time periods
Add confidence_interval_for_rate(failure_counts: list[float], confidence: float = 0.95) -> dict method that uses StatisticalAnalyzer.compute_confidence_interval
Ensure all parent FailureAnalyzer methods (root_cause_analysis, extract_success_factors, etc.) still work via inheritance

Create tests/test_statistical_failure_analyzer.py with tests covering: is_significant_pattern with significant vs non-significant data, trend_analysis detecting upward/downward/flat, compare_periods detecting improvement, confidence_interval_for_rate, inherited methods still functional
acceptance_criteria: All existing FailureAnalyzer tests still pass
